sn35.109:1.1: Saṃyojaniye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi saṃyojanañ ca ||
sn35.109:1.3: Katame ca bhikkhave saṃyojaniyā dhammā katamañ ca saṃyojanaṃ || || 4-9
sn35.109:1.5: yo tattha chandarāgo || tam tattha saṃyojamaṃ || || la ||
sn35.109:1.8: yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || || 10
sn35.109:1.9: Ime vuccanti bhikkhave saṃyojaniyā dhammā idaṃ saṃyojananti || || 2
